subject: POC environment activation — alignment & handoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <cpark@hospiclinic.com>; Procurement Team <procure@hospiclinic.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Apr 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC environment activation — initial alignment

Hi Claire / Hospiclinic team,

Thanks for the productive session today. Per our MAP conversation, attaching the working MAP spreadsheet with the activation items we discussed. High-level asks we need to lock to start the POC this month: 

- Org & IAM: Redwood will create a sandbox org for your evaluation. We need the list of 2 owners + 3 engineers to be added so we can pre-provision roles.
- API keys: We will issue scoped API keys for the POC (30-day TTL). We require a point of contact for key rotation and who should receive the initial keys.
- IP allowlist: Please confirm the public egress IP ranges you will allow (or specify CIDRs) for the testing window below.
- VPC peering: We recommend a single peering session (one AZ pair) for the POC; please confirm a maintenance window to configure peering.

Proposed timeline (MAP milestones):
- 2029-04-12: Provide list of internal users + firewall CIDRs (Hospiclinic)
- 2029-04-13: Redwood creates org + issues initial API keys
- 2029-04-14: VPC peering configuration and smoke tests
- 2029-04-17: Begin evaluation run (1 week smoke + performance checks)

Please review the MAP_v1.xlsx attached and add rows if you have procurement or security gating items I missed. If procurement needs a separate procurement SOW/PO, loop them in and we’ll accelerate.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Claire Park <cpark@hospiclinic.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@hospiclinic.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 09:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC environment activation — initial alignment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — attaching the signed SOW from procurement so we have a clean paper trail. We can commit to the proposed timeline with two small caveats below.

1) Firewall CIDRs: our security team will allow the following outbound egress ranges for the POC window: 34.223.192.0/24 and 18.205.32.0/24. Please confirm these match the IPs you require on your side.
2) VPC peering window: we prefer peering to happen on 2029-04-14 between 02:00-05:00 UTC (off-hours). That aligns with our change window.

Procurement note: we attached Signed_SOW.pdf — procurement can raise the PO on 2029-04-11 once you confirm final billing contact and billing email.

Claire Park
Director of Platform Eng, Hospiclinic
cpark@hospiclinic.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC environment activation — network & API details

Hi all — tagging in a short technical plan so operations can prep.

1) VPC peering details (Redwood side):
- Redwood VPC CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16
- Peering endpoint: vpce-0a1b2c3d
- Required routes to advertise from Hospiclinic: 10.40.0.0/16 -> via peering (we only need the single CIDR for the POC)
- Security groups: we will only open HTTPS (443) and telemetry ports to the peer.

2) API keys & org setup:
- Proposed flow: Marissa to confirm POC owners. Redwood will create the evaluation org and pre-populate two admin users. We will then generate scoped API keys per-engineer (namespaced keys) and share via secure link (encrypted one-time download). Keys have 30-day TTL and can be rotated manually from the Console.
- For auditing we will enable token-level logs for the POC and share weekly token usage export.

3) IP allowlist:
- Confirmed: 34.223.192.0/24 and 18.205.32.0/24 (Hospiclinic). Please ensure any NAT/egress siting does not translate those addresses. If you have additional NAT ranges please include them in the MAP sheet.

4) Smoke test plan (post-peering):
- 30m connectivity check (ping + TLS handshake)
- sample inference call (100 requests) to validate latency and auth
- KV/cache warmup run (small batch)

Attachments: vpc_peering_template.txt (peer config template)

Jonas Weber
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
[attachment: vpc_peering_template.txt (text)]
